<function name="GodDisable" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Disables god mode on the player. Removes the <page text="FL_GODMODE">Enums/FL#FL_GODMODE</page> flag from the player.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<file line="232-L240">lua/includes/extensions/player.lua</file>
</function>

<example>

end
